# Specter Core
> Sovereign Autonomous Multi-Agent Mesh, Interactive PowerShell Terminal, and OpenAI-Compatible Inference Gateway.

## Overview
Specter Core is an open-source, ultra-lightweight coordination framework designed for multi-agent swarms. It bridges disparate AI agents (Grok, ChatGPT, Claude, open-weight models) via local REST endpoints, Model Context Protocol (MCP) JSON-RPC, and an interactive PowerShell terminal with automated session logging.

## Key Features
- **PowerShell Interactive Hub (`specter-terminal`)**: ANSI terminal UI with real-time atomic session logging in .txt files, zero-spam background event monitoring, and tunnel broadcast.
- **Model Context Protocol Server (`specter-mcp`)**: Native JSON-RPC 2.0 Stdio MCP hub for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and VS Code.
- **OpenAI-Compatible Gateway (`specter-gateway`)**: Pure Python standard library HTTP/1.1 inference server supporting `/v1/chat/completions` with SSE streaming.
- **Sovereign Isolation**: Zero internal host leakage doctrine. Safe environment abstraction with `.env.example`.
- **Deterministic Broker**: SQLite WAL transaction guarantees with SHA-256 execution receipts.
